import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to;
        long cap;
        long flow;
        int rev;

        Edge(int t, long c, int r) {
            to = t;
            cap = c;
            flow = 0;
            rev = r;
        }
    }

    static class DinicFlow {
        int n, s, t;
        List<List<Edge>> g;
        int[] lev, cur;

        DinicFlow(int nodes, int src, int dst) {
            n = nodes;
            s = src;
            t = dst;
            g = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            lev = new int[n];
            cur = new int[n];
        }

        void connect(int u, int v, long capacity) {
            g.get(u).add(new Edge(v, capacity, g.get(v).size()));
            g.get(v).add(new Edge(u, 0, g.get(u).size() - 1));
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(lev, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            lev[s] = 0;
            q.offer(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : g.get(u)) {
                    if (e.cap - e.flow > 0 && lev[e.to] == -1) {
                        lev[e.to] = lev[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return lev[t] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int u, long flow) {
            if (u == t) return flow;
            for (int i = cur[u]; i < g.get(u).size(); i++) {
                cur[u] = i;
                Edge e = g.get(u).get(i);
                if (lev[e.to] == lev[u] + 1 && e.cap - e.flow > 0) {
                    long pushed = dfs(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.cap - e.flow));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        g.get(e.to).get(e.rev).flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxFlow() {
            long result = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long pushed = dfs(s, Long.MAX_VALUE);
                    if (pushed <= 0) break;
                    result += pushed;
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static int[][] fireDist = new int[150][150];
    static int[][] reachDist = new int[150][150];
    static int[][] cellIdx = new int[150][150];
    static int n, T;
    static List<String> board, caps;

    static List<int[]> adj(int r, int c) {
        List<int[]> res = new ArrayList<>();
        if (r + 1 < n) res.add(new int[]{r + 1, c});
        if (r - 1 >= 0) res.add(new int[]{r - 1, c});
        if (c + 1 < n) res.add(new int[]{r, c + 1});
        if (c - 1 >= 0) res.add(new int[]{r, c - 1});
        return res;
    }

    static void fireBFS(int sr, int sc) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(fireDist[i], -1);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        fireDist[sr][sc] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{sr, sc});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
            for (int[] neighbor : adj(r, c)) {
                int nr = neighbor[0], nc = neighbor[1];
                char ch = board.get(nr).charAt(nc);
                if ((ch != 'Z' && !Character.isDigit(ch)) || fireDist[nr][nc] != -1) continue;
                fireDist[nr][nc] = fireDist[r][c] + 1;
                q.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(board.get(i).charAt(j)) && fireDist[i][j] == -1) {
                    fireDist[i][j] = T;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void reachBFS(int sr, int sc) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(reachDist[i], -1);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        reachDist[sr][sc] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{sr, sc});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
            for (int[] neighbor : adj(r, c)) {
                int nr = neighbor[0], nc = neighbor[1];
                if (!Character.isDigit(board.get(nr).charAt(nc)) || reachDist[nr][nc] != -1) continue;
                reachDist[nr][nc] = reachDist[r][c] + 1;
                q.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        T = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        board = new ArrayList<>();
        caps = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            board.add(br.readLine());
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            caps.add(br.readLine());
        }

        int fireR = -1, fireC = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                cellIdx[i][j] = i * n + j + 1;
                if (board.get(i).charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    fireR = i;
                    fireC = j;
                }
            }
        }

        fireBFS(fireR, fireC);

        int totalNodes = 2 * n * n + 2;
        DinicFlow flowNet = new DinicFlow(totalNodes, 0, totalNodes - 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(board.get(i).charAt(j))) {
                    int people = board.get(i).charAt(j) - '0';
                    flowNet.connect(0, cellIdx[i][j], people);
                    reachBFS(i, j);
                    for (int r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                        for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                            if (Character.isDigit(caps.get(r).charAt(c)) && reachDist[r][c] != -1 &&
                                    reachDist[r][c] <= fireDist[r][c] && reachDist[r][c] <= T) {
                                boolean ok = true;
                                if (reachDist[r][c] == fireDist[r][c]) {
                                    ok = false;
                                    for (int[] neighbor : adj(r, c)) {
                                        int nr = neighbor[0], nc = neighbor[1];
                                        if (reachDist[nr][nc] != -1 &&
                                                reachDist[nr][nc] < fireDist[nr][nc]) {
                                            ok = true;
                                            break;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                if (ok) {
                                    flowNet.connect(cellIdx[i][j], n * n + cellIdx[r][c], people);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(caps.get(i).charAt(j))) {
                    int cap = caps.get(i).charAt(j) - '0';
                    flowNet.connect(n * n + cellIdx[i][j], totalNodes - 1, cap);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(flowNet.maxFlow());
    }
}
